description.text: Program Overview Occupational Health and Safety Engineeringis a discipline and specialty that studies and implements practical aspects of protection and safety. In simple terms it is what organizations must do to make sure that their activities do not cause harm to anyone. Teaching Objectives Nature applied talents with strong practical ability and familiar with basic theory and basic knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Engineering MainCourses System Safety Engineering, Safety Principle, Safety Testing and Monitoring, Safety Law, Safety Technologyand other Characteristic Courses Duration 4years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Safety Engineering by China University of Mining And Technology Future Career The graduates mainly work in the relevant enterprises, intermediary agencies and scientific research units such as institutions of higher learning in the Safety Technology and Engineering, Safety Inspection and Supervision, Safety Design and Production, Safety Education and Training of Senior Engineering in Building, Chemical, Mining, Energy and Transportation field.

duration.text: The Safety Engineering at China University of Mining And Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2027 USD/per year ￥ 14600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5. Bank Statement (No less than 20000RMB) 6. Non-criminal certificate 7. Physical examination form

requirements.text: Applicants should have a good school record and be in good health，the applicants for undergraduate degree should be below 30 years old.
